snov_prison.updateNotes: Fixed some bugs, more robust item confiscation and more configurables

snov_stretcher.updateNotes: Small Bugfix regarding stretcher load/unload due to Vehicle Flags

snov_importcars.updateNotes: The dealership can now buy vehicles from players and sell them to companies, with special vehicles (police cars, limousines) in their own storage tab. Also closes an SQL injection and several unguarded callbacks - existing installations must run the ALTER statements in createDatabase.sql.

snov_cuffs.updateNotes: All in-game text now runs through ox_lib locales, with German and English included - nothing is hardcoded German any more, and another language is just a JSON file in locales/. The ox_inventory item definitions and matching item images now ship in the items/ folder, so handcuffs, zipties, ankle cuffs, cuff keys and pliers no longer have to be written by hand.

snov_sperrzone.updateNotes: automatic npc clearing & type specific zones

snov_farming.updateNotes: Clearer farming error messages (depleted zones now show the correct message instead of a generic failure); fixed hidden skills leaking into the skills menu

snov_evidence.updateNotes: Robberies now leave traces behind. Fingerprints and DNA can be created at a location instead of only on a vehicle, and officers dust for them at the scene with the fingerprint brush; the brush previously only worked from a driver's seat. Also fixes glove detection for female characters, who were read as gloved with bare hands and therefore never left a fingerprint, and who could not put on latex gloves at all.

snov_license.updateNotes: Written firearms theory exam at the Ammu-Nation replaces the pay-and-receive weapon_training: a custom NUI form drawn from the Waffengesetz, server-graded with an on-screen result breakdown and a non-refundable attempt fee. Passing files an official, stamped Ammu-Nation certificate into the citizen's inventory (via snov_documents), with an NPC reprint for lost copies.

snov_mdt.updateNotes: Fixes the ALPR plate reader, which could come up blank or stop scanning entirely after being toggled. Recommended for everyone on the previous release.

snov_banking_billing.updateNotes: Extended the invoice source index to cover per-suspect lookups (migration 002) - required by the snov_mdt 1.5.0 manual billing redesign, which reads invoice status live from banking.

snov_documents.updateNotes: Filing cabinets and mailboxes: place them as a prop or a zone from the new Infrastructure tab, sort paperwork into named compartments, and let other resources fill mailboxes through a server export API. Requires migrations 014 through 017.
